class.name: FmodDspSettings
class.brief_description: DSP buffer size and count settings for the FMOD Core system.
class.description:
FmodDspSettings controls the DSP (Digital Signal Processing) buffer configuration. Smaller buffers reduce audio latency but increase CPU overhead. Apply with [method FmodServer.set_system_dsp_buffer_size] before calling [method FmodServer.init].
Read the current values back with [method FmodServer.get_system_dsp_buffer_settings].

method.name: get_dsp_buffer_count
method.description: Returns the number of DSP buffers.

method.name: get_dsp_buffer_size
method.description: Returns the DSP buffer size in samples.

method.name: set_dsp_buffer_count
method.description: Sets the number of DSP buffers. More buffers increase stability at the cost of higher latency.

method.name: set_dsp_buffer_size
method.description: Sets the DSP buffer size in samples. Typical values: [code]256[/code] (low latency), [code]512[/code] (default), [code]1024[/code] (stable).

members.member: Number of DSP buffers. Default is [code]4[/code].
DSP buffer size in samples. Default is [code]512[/code].
